usage: 枕頭 functions as a noun and refers to the object used to support the head while sleeping.
It can be used to specify a particular pillow, e.g., 'my pillow' or describe its type.
枕頭 can appear as the object in a sentence, such as 'I bought a new pillow.'
It can also be the subject in a sentence, e.g., 'The pillow is soft.'
In daily conversations, 枕頭 is used straightforwardly without many grammatical changes.
